summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 9 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503, awaits execution. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five AE orders reported stuck. Four progressed to COMPLETED. One order AE260812-57849665 remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED after color swap and partial cancellation. Parallel investigation launched covering DB state, Kibana logs, and codebase trace. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two completed AE orders had trade-in devices rejected by NorthLadder, triggering clawback. Checkout.com declined clawback authorization on both — ClawbackProcess stuck in RUNNING. Remediation script not yet created, awaits confirmation on re-trigger approach. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation in progress. Lock file created but no RCA written yet. Parallel fan-out launched covering DB state verification, Kibana log search, and codebase trace. Findings not yet synthesized — next step is to complete analysis. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  No RCA file found for this ticket. Investigation not yet started. Ticket appears in EOD generation run but no analysis content was available. Next step is to fetch and investigate the ticket details. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation in progress. Lock file exists but no RCA content written yet. Parallel fan-out investigation was launched covering DB state, Kibana logs, codebase trace, and PC ticket search. Findings not yet synthesized. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA SC+ orders with SMC errors at processExternalServices. 11 remediated after SMC team completed device and product mappings. 3 remain blocked — A36 device model, invalid identity document, and unmapped product ID. Reuse PC-52678 after SMC confirms mappings. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  No substantive RCA content found. File contains residual EOD generation logs rather than actual investigation findings. Investigation not yet completed. Next step is to fetch ticket details and run full investigation workflow. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  No substantive RCA content found. File contains residual EOD generation logs from a prior run rather than actual investigation findings. Investigation not yet completed. Next step is to fetch and investigate the ticket. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. SaSalesReport.groovy needs two new @ColumnMethod handlers. Infrastructure exists in type system. Implementation completed under PC-53689 — updated Groovy script adds both columns using native Order getters. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  Refund failure investigation for 18 SA-region orders. Sub requested re-push of auto refund triggers or confirmation refunds won't fire for manual processing. Parallel fan-out launched covering DB state, Kibana, codebase trace, and PC search. Analysis in progress.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
